title: The Icy Rooms
physical_identity: Sub-section of Level 0, described as nearly identical to Level 0 but covered in ice and very cold; frost-laced carpet, frozen wallpaper scraps, giant ice cubes, frosty-mist air vents.
scale_topology: Not stated; rooms small relative to the giant ice cubes inside them. Indoor.
anomalies: gigantic ice cubes nearly filling small rooms
lighting_sound: Lighting only mentioned as 'improved' in remodel email; sound not stated.

entrances.quote: Level 0.3 is a sub-section of Level 0.

signature_mechanic: A Level 0 clone frozen in ice; vents keep pumping frosty mist and ruin any repair. The remodel email thread shows the fix failing and ends with the crews gone.
do_not: add a monster for vanished task forces
treat sarcastic 'pristine' remodel as true state
